model.browsing: PROHIBITED_BY_PROMPT; UI tool state must be logged if visible
model.memory: Record UI state if known; fresh chats recommended

execution.on_format_failure: Preserve original; one format-only retry is permitted, recorded as deviation; if still invalid, mark case failed, not zero-score
execution.timing: manual UI timestamps if recorded; latency/token/API costs NA if unavailable

prompts.B_guard: exact ordered subsequence of A IDs, with no new/reworded claims and no new retrieval

scoring.primary_metric: post-only-supported-claim count / total supported factual-claim count, calculated per arm from cited sources; pooled over 11 questions; lower better
scoring.primary_zero_denominator: NA (never zero); also report claim totals and answer completeness
scoring.post_only_means: Every fact-supporting cited passage is post-cutoff; claims with any sufficient pre-cutoff cited support are not POST_ONLY; unsupported/uncertain excluded and separately reported
scoring.uncertainty: Report UNCERTAIN separately; do not impute supported or unsupported
scoring.micro_primary: Micro-pooled claims across held-out cases; show per-question rates, paired differences only where both denominators >0
scoring.zero_baseline: If A post-only numerator is 0, do not calculate relative improvement; report absolute counts, other quality metrics, and ceiling effect
scoring.failure_analysis: Record >=1 real verifier error or no-error case; no invented error examples

annotation.atomic_claims: Separate compound claims consistently; freeze mapping before scoring output
annotation.blind_review: Annotate unique A claims without showing B retention decisions where practical; B inherits those labels
annotation.evidence: citation support separately from contextual factual support; do not use postcutoff source as historical citation support

manuscript_claim_scope: Exploratory controlled comparison with handcrafted fixed-context passages, small n=11, manually operated ChatGPT interface; no claims about RAG retrieval improvement
